name: google-docs
description: Google Docs: read documents (with tabs), create, insert text, replace text for templates, raw batch updates (OAuth or service account)

nodes.title: Get document
nodes.description: A document's structure and text (body.content, or tabs[] with include_tabs_content)

include_tabs_content.description: Return every tab in tabs[] instead of only the first tab in body

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create document
nodes.description: Create an empty document with a title (in the root of the caller's Drive)

document_title.description: Title of the new document (sent as `title`)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Insert text
nodes.description: Insert text at an index, or append it at the end of the body

text.description: Text to insert; \n starts a new paragraph

index.description: UTF-16 index to insert at (1 is the start of the body); default: the end of the body

required_revision_id.description: Fail instead of editing if the document changed since this revisionId

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Replace text
nodes.description: Replace every occurrence of a text, e.g. template placeholders like {{name}}

replace_with.description: Replacement text (required unless delete_matches is true)

delete_matches.description: true deletes every match instead of replacing it (agent tools need GOOGLE_DOCS_TOOL_ALLOW_BATCH_UPDATE=1)

required_revision_id.description: Fail instead of editing if the document changed since this revisionId

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Batch update
nodes.description: Apply raw batchUpdate requests (formatting, tables, images, deletions, ...) (as an agent tool only when GOOGLE_DOCS_TOOL_ALLOW_BATCH_UPDATE=1)

required_revision_id.description: Fail instead of editing if the document changed since this revisionId

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Google Docs API request
nodes.description: Call any Google Docs API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/documents/<id>". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/documents/<id>"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
